case_title: BRENDAN NOEL BOGGINS VS. BRITTANI MORGAN

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-26-2022 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BOGGINS, BRENDAN NOEL IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT MORGAN, BRITTANI FAILED TO SUSTAIN BURDEN. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY BOGGINS, BRENDAN NOEL AS TO DEFENDANT MORGAN, BRITTANI ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-26-2022 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$40.00);REMARKS - RESPONDENT CAME TO THE SHERIFF'S OFFICE AT CITY HALL, ROOM 456 AND WAS SERVED THE DOCUMENTS. SERVED AUG-24-2022, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT MORGAN, BRITTANI

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-26-2022 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-26-2022 BY RONALD E. QUIDACHAY. PLAINTIFF BRENDAN NOEL BOGGINS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT BRITTANI MORGAN IS PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: RONALD E. QUIDACHAY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
